# alerts

Alerts and notifications.

- Toolset name: `alerts`
- Enabled by default: yes
- Tools: 5 (2 read-only)

## Tools

### `openvas_create_alert`

**Create alert** · mutating

Create an alert binding an event, condition and method (e.g. email on task_run_status_changed with event_data {"status": "Done"}). The event/condition/method values are the gateway's snake_case identifiers. Not idempotent.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `comment` | string | no | Optional comment |
| `condition` | string | yes | Trigger condition: always, filter_count_at_least, filter_count_changed, severity_at_least or severity_changed |
| `condition_data` | object<string, string> | no | Condition parameters, e.g. {"severity": "7.0"} |
| `event` | string | yes | Trigger event: task_run_status_changed, updated_secinfo or new_secinfo |
| `event_data` | object<string, string> | no | Event parameters, e.g. {"status": "Done"} |
| `filter_id` | string | no | UUID of a filter restricting which results the alert reports |
| `method` | string | yes | Delivery method: email, http_get, scp, send_email, smb, snmp, sourcefire_connector, start_task, syslog, tippingpoint, verinice_ce, verinice_net or alemba |
| `method_data` | object<string, string> | no | Method parameters, e.g. {"to_address": "sec@example.com"} |
| `name` | string | yes | Alert name |

### `openvas_delete_alert`

**Delete alert** · destructive

Delete an alert (to the trashcan by default; `ultimate` deletes permanently). Fails with 409 if a task still uses it.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |
| `ultimate` | boolean | no | Permanently delete instead of moving to the trashcan (default false) |

### `openvas_get_alert`

**Get alert** · read-only

Get one alert by UUID, including event/condition/method data.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |

### `openvas_list_alerts`

**List alerts** · read-only

List alerts (notifications triggered by task events).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` | string | no | GMP filter expression, e.g. `name~webserver and severity>5` |
| `filter_id` | string | no | UUID of a saved filter to apply |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, 1-indexed (default 1) (min 0) |
| `per_page` | integer | no | Items per page, 1-1000 (default 25) (min 0) |

### `openvas_update_alert`

**Update alert** · destructive

Update an alert. Idempotent (PUT): omitted fields stay unchanged.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `comment` | string | no |  |
| `condition` | string | no | Same values as openvas_create_alert |
| `condition_data` | object<string, string> | no |  |
| `event` | string | no | Same values as openvas_create_alert |
| `event_data` | object<string, string> | no |  |
| `filter_id` | string | no |  |
| `id` | string | yes | UUID of the alert to update |
| `method` | string | no | Same values as openvas_create_alert |
| `method_data` | object<string, string> | no |  |
| `name` | string | no |  |
